connector.name: Kudosity
connector.registryDescription: Send SMS, MMS and WhatsApp, manage contacts and webhooks, from AI agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package kudosity-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.kudosity, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KUDOSITY_API_KEY
env.description: Your Kudosity API key (Settings → API Settings).

env.name: KUDOSITY_API_SECRET
env.description: Your Kudosity API secret. Required only for contact-list and balance tools.
